offlineHelpIntro: This bundled guide explains the controls and possible status messages. It does not show the current status of your print jobs.
title: Fin3000 Printer
setupExplanation: Set up “An Fin3000 senden (Cloud-Upload)” for your Linux user. Fin3000 Printer will start in the background when you sign in to Linux. Existing printers and your default printer remain unchanged.
connectExplanation: Sign in using your browser. The printer is ready only after confirmation and secure credential storage.
readyExplanation: Choose “An Fin3000 senden (Cloud-Upload)” when printing. Every upload requires your confirmation in this window. Firefox may show “Fin3000-…” instead. In Chrome/Chromium, open the system print dialog with Ctrl+Shift+P.
lockedExplanation: Unlock your session. Unconfirmed print copies will not be sent automatically later.
loginWorking: Please finish signing in using your browser.
draining: The printer is no longer accepting new jobs
drainExplanation: Unresolved outcomes remain available in Fin3000. Removing the queue does not delete documents or local recovery records.
removedExplanation: Your Fin3000 print queue was removed. Invoices and recovery data are retained. The app is still installed: close and reopen it to set up again. To uninstall it, use Ubuntu's package manager.
exportSaved: Status file saved. It contains only technical operation identifiers, not an invoice or login credentials. Keep it safe and open print status in your original Fin3000 account to resolve this operation. The file does not confirm receipt of an invoice.
exportFailed: The status file could not be saved completely. Choose a new filename in a local folder. Existing files are never overwritten. A possibly incomplete new file is not a valid backup; your local print status is still retained.
receiptExplanation: Open print status in your original Fin3000 account and copy the current signed confirmation for this exact operation. Paste it here. The app checks its signature, account, destination and validity. No invoice is sent again.
receiptInvalid: The confirmation is invalid, expired or belongs to a different operation. Get a new confirmation for this print from your original Fin3000 account. Print status has not changed; do not print again.
recoveryNotAvailable: This operation does not currently need recovery or is being checked. Review its current status.
empty: No print jobs yet. Print an invoice from your browser or another application first.
confirmNotice: This print copy will be uploaded to your Fin3000 account. It may differ from the original invoice and may not contain structured e-invoice data.
countdown: You have {seconds} seconds left to confirm.
waiting: Waiting for the previous print job.
uncertain: The outcome is not yet known. Do not print again. Resolve this operation first.
accepted: Print copy received. Checks are running.
never_accepted: This print copy was verifiably not accepted. You may print it again.
cancelled: Cancelled before the print copy was sent. Print it again if needed.
keyringLocked: Your login keyring is locked. Unlock it in “Passwords and Keys” or sign in to Linux again. Then reconnect.
secretUnavailable: The secure login keyring is unavailable. Without it, no credentials will be stored and no documents will be sent.
revocationPending: Sign-out has not been confirmed yet. No new print jobs are being accepted. Check your internet connection and choose “Prepare for removal” again.
revocationNeedsAccount: After an interrupted sign-in, revoke the printer connection directly in your Fin3000 account. The app cannot confirm a complete sign-out. Unresolved print operations are retained.
setupConflict: The existing printer or security configuration differs. It was not overwritten. Please have the Fin3000 setup checked.
autostartUnavailable: Automatic startup for your Linux user could not be verified. No new documents will be sent. Retry printer setup. If it remains unavailable, have the user service checked; custom settings and disabled-by-policy services are not overwritten.
pendingJobs: The print queue still has pending jobs. Resolve or cancel them in your Linux printer settings first.
originalAccount: Sign in with the original Fin3000 account to resolve the pending operation.
queueFull: Three print jobs are already pending. Wait for them to finish, then print this document again.
reprint: This print copy was not handed over. Connect your account first, then print it again.
runtimeFailed: Fin3000 Printer could not start safely. No new documents will be sent. Existing unresolved outcomes remain available for recovery.
actionFailed: The operation could not be completed. Check your connection and print status before printing again.
installerExplanation: Install Fin3000 Printer for Ubuntu 24.04 or 26.04 with GNOME/Wayland on an Intel or AMD 64-bit computer. Linux will ask for administrative confirmation.
installerTrust: This setup program comes from the HTTPS download on fin3000.com. Ubuntu App Center does not automatically verify our separate signature when opening a downloaded DEB file.
installerUpdates: The printer and future updates come from our APT package source. APT verifies its signature and package checksums. Removing only the printer leaves this source installed.
installerReady: Not installed yet. Click Install when you want to continue.
installerOpenFailed: The printer could not be opened. Look for Fin3000 Printer in your applications.
installerWorking: Ubuntu is verifying and installing packages. Please wait. Installation continues even if you close this window.
installerComplete: Installation completed. Open the printer, configure your print queue and connect your Fin3000 account.
installerSourceChanged: The package source, its approval or its key has changed. Setup has not overwritten or reenabled anything. Please have the package source checked.
installerUnsupported: This version is only intended for Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04 on Intel/AMD 64-bit computers.
installerUnavailable: No suitable approved printer version is currently available. No substitute package was installed.
installerBusy: Another Fin3000 installation is already running. Wait for it to finish.
installerNetwork: The package source could not be verified successfully. Check your internet connection and system clock, then try again.
installerNoDowngrade: A newer printer version is already installed. It has not been replaced by an older version.
installerFailed: Installation was not authorized or could not finish. Completed package steps have not been automatically rolled back. Check Ubuntu's package manager before trying again.
installerRestored: The update failed. The previous printer version has been restored. You can open the printer again.
